profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cox Automotive Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer for the Seller Tools Teams
•	Working in a Kanvan team using Rally for project management and story tracking.
•	Creating and maintaining web apps primarily using an Angular with NgRx frontend and a Ruby backend
•	Write unit tests using Jest, Jasmine, Cypress, and Capybara and conduct quality assurance testing
•	Setup and maintain serverless API’s using AWS lambdas and services
•	Suggested and led initiatives to improve application performance and improve the code base architecture
•	Onboarded and mentored new team members and helped onboard a new team
•	Coordinated integrations with API’s and applications with multiple teams
•	Worked on a mobile application using a React Native frontend and Java backend
•	Manage production deployments and assist with customer support and production environment issues
•	Adapt quickly to new projects and team changes
•	Performed role as the team’s Tech Lead

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Developer for the Seller Tools Express Team
•	Working in a Kanvan team using Rally for project management and story tracking.
•	Performed role as the team’s Tech Lead
•	Creating and maintaining web apps using an Angular and Typescript frontend and Ruby backend
•	Write unit tests and conduct quality assurance testing
•	Provide feedback to help improve user interaction with the web app
•	Assisted with customer support and production environment issues

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Working in an agile (Scrum) team using JIRA for project management and story tracking.
•	Created web pages and web apps using AngularJS, Bootstrap, RESTful services, and React
•	Enhanced and improved functionality, speed, and reliability of older web pages
•	Modified and created file processing services using Java and Tibco BusinessWorks and BusinessEvents
•	Altered and developed Oracle SQL queries
•	Led the creation and setup of a new test environment
•	Provided environmental support for development and test servers
•	Managed multiple production releases
•	Assisted with performing quality and security testing
•	Participated in two internal code fest by designing and creating AngularJS and Bootstrap web apps

positions.title: Associate IT Developer
positions.description:
Research and development for the application of emerging technologies
•	Created Android apps to research location detection via Bluetooth beacons, Wi-Fi networks, and LED Lights
•	3D modeling, printing, and scanning
•	Helped improve the quality of the new facility by restructuring project management and daily workflow

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Web based reports of operational data
   •	Goal: Create reports to provide access to operational data in near-real time
   •	Roles: 	
      -	Modify SQL queries to access the database and pull information for each report
      -	Implemented the creation of a report using Java and a Jersey based RESTful service
      -	Reports were created in PDF, Excel, and Jquery webpage formats

Performance and production simulation tool
   •	Goal: Use Java, RESTful services, and a Batch framework to simulate daily volume of reports (up to 2000).
   •	Role: Developed an automatic email service to send simulation results as Excel files

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
Received a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and a Certificate in Engineering Psychology. My computer science threads are Devices and Platforms (Systems and Architecture).
GPA: 3.23/4.0

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Small motel in Northern Georgia
Maintained the property (cleaning rooms, repairing doors and ice machines, unclogging tubs and toilets, etc.)
Troubleshooting electronic and network problems.
Desk Clerk
Installed new software on property laptops and desktop computers
Installed new hardware (Vending machines and Ice Machine)

projects.title: MAKE Persistence of Vision (POV) Spinner
projects.description: Working with a team to build and program a persistence of vision spinner using C and an Arduino microcontroller

projects.title: 3D Photovoltaics Modeling
projects.description: Currently working in a team of four to create a computer simulation of photovoltaic cells. The cells will be manufactured by the Ready-Lab at Georgia Tech. These solar cells will be placed on the International Space Station in Fall 2014. Implemented the storage and export of data created by the simulation using comma separated value files

organizations.name: MAKE
organizations.description: A club based on prototyping, designing, and programming devices
